title: Evaluation case p6-vendor-incident: everybody fails to sign in during an incident on the vendor side
scenario: Everybody fails to sign in during an incident on the vendor side.

events.title: Nobody can sign in to Teams
events.text: Since 14:05 UTC people at all our sites cannot sign in to Teams, about 300 users so far. Now and then a second attempt works. Before writing I checked our own network and nothing there has changed.

events.title: Service health check
events.text: Microsoft's service health shows an active incident for sign-in and Teams that began at 14:00 UTC, with the same symptoms you describe.

events.title: Re: Nobody can sign in to Teams
events.text: This matches an incident on the Microsoft side, so there is nothing for you to change. I will keep you posted as the incident page updates.

events.title: Re: Nobody can sign in to Teams
events.text: Thank you. Our users now see an error saying that the connection timed out.

events.title: Incident update
events.text: The incident page now says Microsoft has resolved it as of 17:40 UTC. I asked three users to sign in and they all got in.
